{{Quote|Engage me at your peril.|Diala Passil|<ref name="IA Core Set" />}}
'''Diala Passil''' was a female [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who allied herself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]]. She survived into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My master taught me how to be swift. It did not save him, but I shall not forget his teachings.|Diala Passil|<ref name="IA Core Set" />}}
Diala Passil was a Jedi Padawan, apprenticed to [[Shu Yen]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Her master did not survive the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], though his teachings helped her to escape execution and survive the Jedi Purge. Passil adhered to her master's teachings and fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="IA Core Set" />
